_comment: Canonical city -> spellings seen in the source. Transliteration variants (BEYROUTH/BEYRUT) and non-geographic markers (ECOM, INTERNAL) both collapse here. A marker is kept as its own value rather than blanked: 'this transaction had no merchant location' is information, and it is not the same statement as 'the location is unknown'.
_non_geographic_comment: Values that occupy the city column without naming a place. INTERNAL covers 24614 rows and is exclusively bank-internal traffic -- settlement, transfer, salary, interest, fee, card payment -- with zero purchases, so it marks an on-us movement rather than a missing city. Neither kind carries a country, and neither is UNKNOWN.
